name: ontology-kit-workspace
description: The Ontology Kit repository: a pnpm workspace holding the packages (the file-format reader in packages/reader, the okb CLI in packages/okb, the ontology-kit wrapper) and the docs site (site), plus repo-wide docs tooling.

scripts.site: pnpm run docs && pnpm example && pnpm --filter ontology-kit-docs run build
scripts.site:dev: pnpm run docs && pnpm example && pnpm --filter ontology-kit-docs run dev
